provenance: new protocol contract; not historical observations
request_identity: Persisted request ID plus complete payload; same ID and different payload refuses
admission: Persist queued admission before acknowledgment or side effects; one native store/guard per ledger
execution: Exactly one running job per ledger; callbacks on the dedicated interpreter execution thread
restart: Queued/running records from a dead instance become uncertain/resume-required; never auto-replay side effects
disconnect: Client disconnect does not cancel, erase or resend an admitted job
retention: At configured record capacity, refuse new IDs; existing duplicate/conflict lookups remain available; never evict records
authorization: Versioned runtime requests require configured loopback Host/origin, matching capability and configuration generation
authority: Only configured role/job/factory/account mappings; no submitted Python, imports, SQL or arbitrary write paths
reads: Nested owner reads are direct, never self-HTTP; legacy GET bytes unchanged
shutdown: Stop admission, signal loops, finish/rollback active transaction, flush heartbeat/logs, close HTTP/readers/store, release guard last; report a blocked plugin rather than fabricate success
errors: Preserve result or exact refusal type/message, observed and committed sequence and request correlation
cli: Preserve existing engine EOD flags/refusals/counts through a native one-shot actor; remote-owner path is explicit
